2607.10557.title: UNIBROWSE: A Data-to-Agent Framework for Multimodal BrowseComp
2607.10557.paper_summary: Multimodal BrowseComp tasks require agents to combine perception, tool use, and long-horizon reasoning over dynamic web content, challenging their ability to handle compositional structure, open-world uncertainty, and multimodal integration across extended interactions. Crucially, real-world multimodal browsing involves three distinct information-flow patterns: text-only, image-to-text, and text-to-image, yet existing data construction methods cover only the text-only and image-to-text patterns, leaving text-to-image largely unaddressed and limiting agent generality and robustness. We introduce UNIBROWSE, a unified data pipeline that for the first time simultaneously generates training data covering all three patterns, augments curated knowledge graphs with live web retrieval for improved fidelity, and introduces a novel metric of exploration degree to filter low-signal instances for efficient reinforcement learning. Through this pipeline, we produce high-quality cold-start tool-use trajectories and exploration-rich QA pairs, and train a 35B-scale agent via supervised fine-tuning and exploration-aware RL.The resulting UNIBROWSE agent achieves state-of-the-art performance on multimodal BrowseComp benchmarks, attaining an average accuracy of 54.4 across five diverse benchmarks -- an improvement of 10.5 points over its base model Qwen3.5-35B-A3B -- and surpassing serveral closed-source agent workflows such as GPT-5 (42.9), Gemini-2.5 Pro (44.8), and Gemini-2.5 Flash (41.3).
2607.10557.paper_summary_zh: 多模態的 BrowseComp 任務要求代理結合感知、工具使用和對動態網絡內容的長期推理，挑戰他們處理組合結構、開放世界不確定性和跨延伸互動的多模態整合的能力。關鍵是，現實世界的多模態瀏覽涉及三種不同的信息流模式：僅文本、圖像到文本和文本到圖像，然而現有的數據構建方法僅涵蓋僅文本和圖像到文本模式，對文本到圖像的處理則幾乎沒有，這限制了代理的通用性和穩健性。我們介紹了 UNIBROWSE，一個統一的數據管道，它首次同時生成涵蓋所有三種模式的訓練數據，並通過實時網絡檢索增強策劃的知識圖譜以提高真實性，還引入了一種新的探索度度量來過濾低信號實例，以便進行高效的強化學習。通過這個管道，我們生成高質量的冷啟動工具使用軌跡和探索豐富的問答對，並通過監督微調和關注探索的強化學習訓練一個 35B 規模的代理。最終的 UNIBROWSE 代理在多模態 BrowseComp 基準上達到了最先進的性能，在五個多樣化基準上獲得了 54.4 的平均準確率，較其基礎模型 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 提高了 10.5 分，並超越了幾個閉源代理工作流程，如 GPT-5 (42.9)、Gemini-2.5 Pro (44.8) 和 Gemini-2.5 Flash (41.3)。
